content.text: Moses wrote all the words of the Lord, Ex. 24:4. tables of stone, written with the finger of God, Ex. 31:18 (Deut. 9:10). blot me … out of thy book which thou hast written, Ex. 32:32. I will write upon these tables the words that were in the first tables, Ex. 34:1 (Deut. 10:2). Lord said unto Moses, Write thou these words, Ex. 34:27. he wrote them upon two tables of stone, Deut. 4:13. write them upon the posts of thy house, Deut. 6:9 (11:20). write ye this song for you, Deut. 31:19. he wrote there upon the stones a copy of the law, Josh. 8:32. acts of Uzziah … did Isaiah … write, 2 Chr. 26:22. volume of the book it is written of me, Ps. 40:7 (Heb. 10:7). written for the generation to come, Ps. 102:18. write them upon the table of thine heart, Prov. 3:3 (7:3). every one that is written among the living, Isa. 4:3 (2 Ne. 14:3). Take thee a great roll, and write in it, Isa. 8:1 (2 Ne. 18:1). write it … and note it in a book, Isa. 30:8. Write thee all the words that I have spoken, Jer. 30:2. law … write it in their hearts, Jer. 31:33 (Heb. 8:10; 10:16). write in it all the former words that … hath burned, Jer. 36:28. take thee one stick, and write upon it, Ezek. 37:16. came forth fingers of a man’s hand, and wrote, Dan. 5:5. this writing was written, Dan. 5:24. Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, Hab. 2:2.

rejoice, because your names are written in heaven, Luke 10:20. all things that are written by the prophets … accomplished, Luke 18:31. Thus it is written, and thus it behoved Christ to suffer, Luke 24:46. We have found him, of whom Moses … did write, John 1:45. believed Moses … for he wrote of me, John 5:46. Jesus … with his finger wrote on the ground, John 8:6. What I have written I have written, John 19:22. many other signs … not written in this book, John 20:30. these are written, that ye might believe, John 20:31. they wrote letters by them after this manner, Acts 15:23. things were written aforetime were written for our learning, Rom. 15:4. written for our admonition, 1 Cor. 10:11. we write none other things unto you, than what ye read, 2 Cor. 1:13. written not with ink, but with the Spirit, 2 Cor. 3:3. church of the firstborn, which are written in heaven, Heb. 12:23. I write no new commandment unto you, 1 Jn. 2:7. These things have I written unto you that believe, 1 Jn. 5:13. I would not write with paper and ink, 2 Jn. 1:12 (3 Jn. 1:13). Write the things which thou hast seen, Rev. 1:19. I will write upon him the name of my God, Rev. 3:12. book written within and on the backside, Rev. 5:1. Write: for these words are true and faithful, Rev. 21:5.

in them shall be written my gospel, 1 Ne. 13:36. apostle of the Lamb … should write them, 1 Ne. 14:25. do not write anything upon plates save it be … sacred, 1 Ne. 19:6. fruit of thy loins shall write, 2 Ne. 3:12. I will write unto him my law, 2 Ne. 3:17. upon these I write the things of my soul … and writeth them for … my children, 2 Ne. 4:15. spoken unto you concerning all things which are written, 2 Ne. 6:3. labor diligently to write, to persuade our children, 2 Ne. 25:23. command all men … write the words which I speak, 2 Ne. 29:11. shall speak unto the Jews and they shall write it … unto all nations of the earth and they shall write it, 2 Ne. 29:12. have written what I have written, and I esteem it as of great worth, 2 Ne. 33:3. commandment that I should write upon these plates, Jacob 1:2 (Jarom 1:1; Omni 1:1; W of M 1:2). written for … benefit of our brethren, Jarom 1:2. commandments … are not written in your hearts, Mosiah 13:11. taught them … that they might write one to another, Mosiah 24:6. many things did Nephi speak which cannot be written, Hel. 8:3. ye shall write these sayings, 3 Ne. 16:4. write the things which I have told you, 3 Ne. 23:4. How be it that ye have not written this thing, 3 Ne. 23:11. Write the things which ye have seen and heard, 3 Ne. 27:23. all things are written by the Father, 3 Ne. 27:26. I write a small abridgment, Morm. 5:9. these things are written unto the remnant … of Jacob, Morm. 5:12. I will write and hide up the records in the earth, Morm. 8:4. ye shall write them and shall seal them up, Ether 3:22. brother of Jared … write the things which he had seen, Ether 4:1. thou hast made us that we could write but little, Ether 12:24. seek this Jesus of whom the prophets and apostles have written, Ether 12:41 (D&C 52:9).

you are called … to write for my servant Joseph, D&C 9:4. in them are all things written concerning the foundation of my church, D&C 18:4. not written that there shall be no end to this torment, D&C 19:6. thou wast … chosen to write the Book of Mormon, D&C 24:1. things which he hath written from that stone are not of me, D&C 28:11. write and keep a regular history, D&C 47:1. for this cause the apostle wrote … a commandment, D&C 74:5. they whose names are written in heaven, D&C 76:68. Lord commanded us to write while we were yet in the Spirit, D&C 76:80. not found written in the book of remembrance shall find none inheritance, D&C 85:9. ye shall write this commandment, D&C 90:32. things were all written in the book of Enoch, D&C 107:57. written … by the power of the Holy Ghost, D&C 124:4. things which were written in the books, D&C 128:6. white stone … whereon is a new name written, D&C 130:11. having his Father’s name written on their foreheads, D&C 133:18. pondered over these things which are written, D&C 138:11.

write the things which I shall speak, Moses 1:40 (2:1). called upon God to write by the spirit of inspiration, Moses 6:5. book of remembrance we have written among us, Moses 6:46. he began to write for me, JS—H 1:67.
